headword: {仕事|しごと}{中毒|ちゅうどく}

definitions.explanation: A person who works compulsively and excessively, or the state of being addicted to work. A calque of the English word 'workaholic.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{仕事|しごと}{中毒|ちゅうどく}だ。
{仕事|しごと}{中毒|ちゅうどく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Being a workaholic, I have no time with my family.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}{中毒|ちゅうどく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧しまうそうだ。
examples.english: Apparently, people who tend to become workaholics can't stop thinking about work even on their days off.

notes:
USAGE:
A Japanese translation of the English concept "workaholic," using ⟦{中毒|ちゅうどく}→中毒：16558_chuudoku⟧ (addiction/poisoning). The loanword ワーカホリック is also used. Can describe both the person and the condition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕事|しごと}{中毒|ちゅうどく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a workaholic)
- {仕事|しごと}{中毒|ちゅうどく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a workaholic person)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ワーカホリック: workaholic — loanword equivalent
- ⟦{過労|かろう}→過労：08563_karou⟧: overwork — focuses on the result rather than the compulsion
- ⟦{働|はたら}き→働く：00503_hataraku⟧すぎ: overworking — colloquial equivalent
